# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 18 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Pharaoh's Son Plots Against Joseph

---

**1** After this, Pharaoh's firstborn son heard what Simeon and Levi had said about Aseneth. He was consumed with grief and jealousy, and he turned his heart against Joseph and Aseneth.

**2** He sent a messenger to Dan and Gad, the sons of Jacob's concubines: 'I know you are brave and powerful men.'

**3** 'And I know you hate your brother Joseph. He sold you to the Ishmaelites and made you suffer. Come to me and I will make you rich and powerful — gold and silver in abundance.'

**4** 'I want to kill Joseph — he is my enemy. And I want Aseneth as my wife. She belongs with me, not with some slave's son like Joseph.'

**5** Dan and Gad said: 'We are your servants and will do whatever you command. Whoever hates our brother Joseph is our friend.'

**6** Pharaoh's firstborn son outlined his plan: 'Tonight I will go to Pentephres' house, kill him and his wife, and take Aseneth as my wife. You go and kill Joseph. And make sure to kill his sons too — otherwise they'll come for revenge.'

**7** 'Done,' they said. 'Whatever you say.' Pharaoh's son brought them into his house and they ate and drank wine together.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
